# QCP test fixtures

From the FFmpeg sample collection, https://samples.ffmpeg.org/A-codecs/ (test material of the FFmpeg
project, used here as demuxer test vectors only).

| File | Source path | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `clap.qcp` | `suite/QCP/clap.qcp` | QCELP, variable rate, 175 packets |
| `test8.qcp` | `suite/QCP/test8.qcp` | QCELP, fixed-size packets (35 bytes) |
| `evrc.qcp` | `EVRC/02_Lord_Of_The_Flies_evrc.qcp` | EVRC, variable rate |
